# Netshare

> Netshare is a free, open-source app for fast, private file sharing between devices on the same local network — no cloud, no account, and no internet required. Available on Android, iOS, and macOS.

This is the Netshare product site at [netfshare.site](https://netfshare.site). Files move directly between devices on your LAN. Markdown versions of key pages are linked below for AI/LLM consumption.

Key facts:
- Local-first transfers over Wi-Fi / LAN
- No cloud uploads for core file sharing
- Works offline or on restricted internal networks
- Cross-platform: Android, iOS, and macOS
- Built with Flutter
- Open source on GitHub

---

## Product

- [Home](https://netfshare.site/index.md): Product overview, features, use cases, and download entry points
- [Download for macOS](https://netfshare.site/download-macos/index.md): Direct DMG download and Mac App Store
- [Technology](https://netfshare.site/technology/index.md): Stack notes, including Flutter for cross-platform development

---

## Features

Netshare is designed for secure local network file sharing:

- Local-first and fast — files move directly between devices on the same network
- Privacy by design — data stays on your network; no uploads to Netshare servers for transfers
- Works without internet — suitable for offices, labs, factories, and internal networks
- Cross-platform — share between computers and mobile devices on Android, iOS, and macOS

---

## Use Cases

- [Internal enterprise](https://netfshare.site/index.md): Share files when cloud tools are restricted or blocked
- [Factories and industrial sites](https://netfshare.site/index.md): Reliable transfers on isolated networks with little or no internet
- [Schools, labs, and hospitals](https://netfshare.site/index.md): Keep sensitive data on-premises while enabling collaboration
- [Dev teams and studios](https://netfshare.site/index.md): Move large builds, exports, and media assets over the LAN
